title: Feeding the 5000, Walking on Water, Bread of Life

questions.question: When Jesus saw a large crowd coming toward Him, He asked Philip where to buy bread. Then Andrew found a boy who had what provisions?
options: Five barley loaves and two fish
Seven loaves and a few small fish
Two loaves and five fish
A dozen loaves and a basket of fish
questions.correctAnswer: Five barley loaves and two fish
questions.explanation: John 6:9 (ESV): "There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish, but what are they for so many?"

questions.question: How many men did Jesus feed with the loaves and fish?
options: About five thousand
About four thousand
About three thousand
Exactly ten thousand
questions.explanation: John 6:10 (ESV): "Jesus said, 'Have the people sit down.' Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, about five thousand in number."

questions.question: After the people had eaten their fill, how many baskets of broken pieces were gathered?
options: Twelve baskets
Seven baskets
Five baskets
Ten baskets
questions.explanation: John 6:13 (ESV): "So they gathered them up and filled twelve baskets with pieces of the five barley loaves left over by those who had eaten."

questions.question: When Jesus perceived that they were about to come and take Him by force to make Him king, what did He do?
options: He withdrew again to the mountain by himself
He called down fire from heaven to warn them
He stood and proclaimed himself king entirely
He walked across the lake immediately
questions.correctAnswer: He withdrew again to the mountain by himself
questions.explanation: John 6:15 (ESV): "Perceiving then that they were about to come and take him by force to make him king, Jesus withdrew again to the mountain by himself."

questions.question: Jesus said to them, "I am the bread of life; whoever comes to me shall not hunger, and whoever believes in me shall never..."?
options: "...thirst."
"...wander entirely."
"...starve completely."
questions.explanation: John 6:35 (ESV): "Jesus said to them, 'I am the bread of life; whoever comes to me shall not hunger, and whoever believes in me shall never thirst.'"

questions.question: When the disciples were rowing in a rough sea in the dark, they were frightened to see Jesus doing what?
options: Walking on the sea and coming near the boat
Flying upon the clouds securely
Standing firmly on a nearby island entirely
Calming the storm from the shore immediately
questions.correctAnswer: Walking on the sea and coming near the boat
questions.explanation: John 6:19 (ESV): "When they had rowed about three or four miles, they saw Jesus walking on the sea and coming near the boat, and they were frightened."

questions.question: What did Jesus say to them on the sea to calm their fear?
options: "It is I; do not be afraid."
"Peace, be still entirely."
"Where is your faith?"
"Fear not the waves, for I command them."
questions.correctAnswer: "It is I; do not be afraid."
questions.explanation: John 6:20 (ESV): "But he said to them, 'It is I; do not be afraid.'"

questions.question: Jesus told the crowd not to work for food that perishes, but for what?
options: For the food that endures to eternal life
For the bread that falls securely from heaven daily
For the harvest of pure righteousness
For the coins that never rust completely
questions.correctAnswer: For the food that endures to eternal life
questions.explanation: John 6:27 (ESV): "Do not work for the food that perishes, but for the food that endures to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give to you."

questions.question: When the crowd asked, "What must we do, to be doing the works of God?", what was Jesus' direct answer?
options: "This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent."
"You must keep the commandments of Moses entirely."
"You must wash your hands before eating the bread of life."
"You must sell all you have to feed the poor entirely."
questions.correctAnswer: "This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent."
questions.explanation: John 6:29 (ESV): "Jesus answered them, 'This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent.'"

questions.question: The Jews grumbled about Him claiming He was the bread that came down from heaven. Who did they know Him to be?
options: Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know
A wild prophet from the desert entirely
A rebellious zealot seeking followers safely
A former priest expelled from the temple
questions.correctAnswer: Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know
questions.explanation: John 6:42 (ESV): "They said, 'Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How does he now say, "I have come down from heaven"?'"

questions.question: Jesus made a challenging statement: "Truly, truly, I say to you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you have..."?
options: "...no life in you."
"...no part with me eternally."
"...denied the very truth completely."
"...misunderstood the ancient prophets entirely."
questions.explanation: John 6:53 (ESV): "So Jesus said to them, 'Truly, truly, I say to you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you have no life in you.'"

questions.question: Why did many of His disciples turn back and no longer walk with Him after this discourse?
options: They said "This is a hard saying; who can listen to it?"
They ran out of provisions completely in the desert
They feared the Roman soldiers approaching rapidly
They decided he was possessed by a demon violently
questions.correctAnswer: They said "This is a hard saying; who can listen to it?"
questions.explanation: John 6:60, 66 (ESV): "When many of his disciples heard it, they said, 'This is a hard saying; who can listen to it?' ... After this many of his disciples turned back and no longer walked with him."

questions.question: When Jesus asked the twelve, "Do you want to go away as well?", how did Simon Peter answer?
options: "Lord, to whom shall we go? You have the words of eternal life"
"Lord, we will follow you unless the Romans come completely."
"Lord, we do not understand fully but we stay safely."
"Lord, provide for us flesh and we will remain entirely."
questions.correctAnswer: "Lord, to whom shall we go? You have the words of eternal life"
questions.explanation: John 6:68 (ESV): "Simon Peter answered him, 'Lord, to whom shall we go? You have the words of eternal life,'"

questions.question: Jesus answered them, "Did I not choose you, the twelve? And yet one of you is..." what?
options: a devil
a thief completely
a deceiver securely
blind to the truth entirely
questions.explanation: John 6:70 (ESV): "Jesus answered them, 'Did I not choose you, the twelve? And yet one of you is a devil.'"

questions.question: Who was Jesus speaking of that would betray Him, though he was one of the twelve?
options: Judas the son of Simon Iscariot
Thomas called the Twin safely
Matthew the former tax collector entirely
Philip of Bethsaida completely
questions.correctAnswer: Judas the son of Simon Iscariot
questions.explanation: John 6:71 (ESV): "He spoke of Judas the son of Simon Iscariot, for he, one of the twelve, was going to betray him."

key_verse_text: Jesus said to them, "I am the bread of life; whoever comes to me shall not hunger, and whoever believes in me shall never thirst."
